notice: Measured on the listed images only. These figures do not predict results on other kinds of image, and no single result from this detector proves that an image is authentic or false.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.licence: Per-file open licences (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA), checked before download and listed in a manifest kept beside the images

comparison.method: Intervals resample the test images 1000 times within each class, using the same images for both detectors. A detector or combination adds value only if the whole 95% interval of its AUC difference from the baseline is above zero. Thresholds and combination members are chosen on the calibration split.
limitations: Several detectors are compared on one set of images, so one could look better by chance.
A difference measured here does not show the detector would do better on other kinds of image.
Recall counts inconclusive results as not flagged.
Images in one split can still be near-duplicates of images in the other, unless they share a perceptual hash.
Labels and licences are as stated by whoever ran this benchmark. The tool does not check them.
